attachment-transfer-limits-invalid-value: Chonde lowetsani mtengo wolondola wa malire oposa ziro
attachment-transfer-limits-title: Malire a kukula kwa mafayilo olumikizidwa ndi API
attachment-upload-limit-label: Kukula kwakukulu kwa fayilo yolumikizidwa yokwezedwa
automatic-linked-url-schemes: Mitundu yapadera ya URL yomwe iyenera kudinika yokha. Mtundu umodzi wa URL pa mzere
board-creation-admin-only: Owongolera okha ndiwo angathe kupanga bolodi
confirm-move-list-to-swimlane: Samutsani mndandanda uwu ndi makhadi ake onse ku mzere wosambira wina?
default-on-public-board: Chokhazikika pa bolodi la anthu onse
delete-board-confirm-popup: Mindandanda, makhadi, zizindikiro ndi zochitika zonse zidzafufutidwa ndipo simudzatha kubwezeretsa zomwe zinali pa bolodi. Palibe kubwezeretsa.
drag-to-reorder: Kokani kuti musinthe dongosolo. Mabatani a mivi yokwera ndi yotsika amasuntha malo amodzi.
enable-permanent-delete: Lolani kuchotsa kosatha kwa Woyang'anira Wapadziko Lonse
enable-permanent-delete-description: Lolani Oyang'anira Apadziko Lonse kuchotsa kosatha zinthu zomwe zachotsedwa mofewa. Kuyatsa zokonda izi sikuchotsa chilichonse pakokha.
feature-approval-required: Siyani zinthu zomwe zosintha za WeKan zawonjezera zili zozimitsidwa mpaka woyang'anira atazitsegula
feature-board-summary-desc: Menyu ya bolodi → Chidule chimawonetsa zomwe aliyense anachita pa bolodi tsiku kapena sabata lomaliza, ndi zomwe zachedwa.
feature-pilot-users: Ogwiritsa ntchito oyesera amene amaonanso zinthu zozimitsidwa
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Mayina a ogwiritsa ntchito, olekanitsidwa ndi makoma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Zasungidwa. Mayina awa a ogwiritsa ntchito sanapezeke:
feature-preview-admins: Oyang'anira amaona zinthu zozimitsidwa kuti aziyesere kaye
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menyu ya bolodi → Malamulo amapereka malamulo kuchokera ku zomwe anthu amachita ndi manja mobwerezabwereza.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Kusaka konse kumamvetsa mawu ngati "makhadi anga omwe achedwa".
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menyu ya bolodi → Kuyambira ulendo wanu womaliza ikuwonetsa zomwe ena asintha pa bolodi.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalendala ndi kalendala ya mabolodi ambiri.
feature-views-chat-desc: Bolodi ngati malo ochezera: malo ogwirira ntchito, mabolodi, njira, mindandanda ndi makhadi ngati mtengo wa matchanelo, khadi pakati ndi ndemanga zake ngati mauthenga a macheza.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Makhadi omwewo m'magulu angapo a mizati okhala ndi mayina - mwa kumaliza, kufunika, gawo kapena china chilichonse - amasunthidwa pakati pa mizati pokoka.
feature-views-email-desc: Bolodi ngati bokosi la makalata: mndandanda wa imelo ndi Bokosi lolandirira, mindandanda ndi mafoda, zilembo ndi zilembo, ndipo mamembala amalemba ndi kuyankha maimelo kuchokera ku adilesi ya bolodi.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Ntchito yotsala ndi yomalizidwa, kuyenda kosonkhanitsidwa, nthawi yozungulira ndi yopereka, kuchuluka kwa ntchito yomalizidwa, nthawi imene ntchito yakhala ilipo, zopinga, Monte Carlo ndi miyeso ina ya kuyenda kwa ntchito.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Maonekedwe atatu a tchati cha Gantt.
feature-views-map-desc: Makhadi ngati zizindikiro pa chithunzi chokwezedwa.
feature-views-overview-desc: Ziwerengero, kugawa m'magulu potengera munthu wopatsidwa ntchito, mapu a dongosolo, bolodi loyang'anira ndi bolodi lalikulu.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Mndandanda wa ntchito za chinthu chopangidwa, nthawi zazifupi za ntchito, lipoti la nthawi ya ntchito ndi liwiro.
feature-views-table-desc: Bolodi ngati tebulo la makhadi lomwe lingasanjidwe.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Bolodi ngati chotsatira mavuto cha GitHub kapena Gitea: makhadi ngati mavuto, zilembo ndi zochitika zazikulu, ndemanga ngati kukambirana, zolumikizidwa ngati mafayilo, ndi mbiri ya bolodi yokhala ndi kubweza.
home-board-empty: Kokerani bolodi limodzi lokha pano kuti litsegulidwe mutalowa
home-board-remove-confirm: Chotsani bolodi ili pa Kunyumba? Bolodi lenilenilo silichotsedwa.
multi-selection-active: Dinani mabokosi owunika kuti musankhe mabodi
set-selected-home: Ikani ngati bolodi la Kunyumba (limatsegulidwa mutalowa)
show-on-public-board: Onetsani pa bolodi la anthu onse
